name: writing-standards
description: Installer for the writing-standards OpenCode skill: Chinese/English academic writing standards (punctuation, digits, quantities & units, mixed-script typesetting, expression, statistical reporting, figures & tables, structure & logic, GB/T 7714 citations, integrity) installed into AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md, plus a figure workflow: journal-grade plots (matplotlib), diagrams (mermaid/TikZ) and three-line tables (booktabs/Word) for LaTeX and Word.
